orbit.name: 1400m Altitude
orbit.desc: High volcanic elevation creating denser beans with concentrated sugars and vibrant acidity.

orbit.name: Cast-Iron Drum
orbit.desc: Cast-iron roasting drum delivering smooth thermal conduction without scorching delicate beans.

orbit.name: First Crack Monitor
orbit.desc: Acoustic audio sensors tracking the precise cellular expansion and caramelization threshold.

orbit.name: Anaerobic Ferment
orbit.desc: Oxygen-free fermentation developing luscious wild berries and champagne-like tasting notes.

orbit.name: Washed Processing
orbit.desc: Mountain spring water washing revealing crystal-clear floral jasmine and citrus brightness.

orbit.name: Agtron Color Index
orbit.desc: Infrared spectrophotometer verifying exact roast development degree across every batch.

orbit.name: Degassing Valve
orbit.desc: One-way freshness valve allowing carbon dioxide to escape while keeping oxygen out.

orbit.name: Burr Calibration
orbit.desc: Titanium coated 64mm flat burrs ensuring identical particle distribution for sweet extraction.

orbit.name: Honey Process
orbit.desc: Sun-dried with sweet fruit mucilage intact for rich caramelized brown sugar and toffee finish.

orbit.name: TDS Refractometer
orbit.desc: Digital optical refractometer targeting the golden extraction ratio between 18% and 22%.

orbit.name: Rate of Rise (RoR)
orbit.desc: Mathematical roast curve monitoring preventing baking and preserving volatile aromatics.

orbit.name: Cupping Protocol
orbit.desc: Triple blind cupping protocol scoring fragrance, aroma, flavor, aftertaste, and balance.

orbit.name: Natural Sun-Drying
orbit.desc: 21 days of slow hand-raked sun drying ensuring uniform moisture equilibrium at 10.5%.

orbit.name: Nitrogen Flush
orbit.desc: Food-grade nitrogen displacement keeping roasted beans at peak sensory vibrancy for months.

orbit.name: Water Mineral Recipe
orbit.desc: Custom 120 PPM mineral water formula extracting nuanced fruit esters without bitterness.

orbit.name: Direct Farm Trade
orbit.desc: Paying 120% above fair-trade market prices directly to smallholder estate cultivators.

orbit.name: Cold Drip Towers
orbit.desc: Slow slow-drip Dutch cold brew towers yielding chocolate liqueur complexity with zero bite.

orbit.name: 100% Compostable
orbit.desc: Certified bio-degradable plant-based kraft outer pouch breaking down harmlessly in soil.

story.title: The Roastcraft Roastery Heritage
story.subtitle: From High-Altitude Shaded Canopy to Your Morning Cup
story.quote: Great coffee is not manufactured; it is coaxed from volcanic soil, slow-ripened under misted mountain canopies, and respected in the roasting drum.
story.author: Aditya Rao
story.description: At Roastcraft, we partner directly with generational coffee estates in the Western Ghats and Ethiopian highlands. We roast exclusively on vintage cast-iron drums in small 12kg batches to preserve the delicate terroir of every harvest.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Uncompromising Dedication to the Perfect Cup
aboutPage.heroDesc: From soil nutrition to the exact second of first crack in the roasting drum, Roastcraft is built on reverence for the humble coffee cherry.

contactPage.title: Connect with Our Brewmasters
contactPage.subtitle: Have questions about grind sizes for your brewing gear, espresso machine calibration, or bulk corporate subscriptions? Our barista team is ready.

reviews.name: Prateek Sundaram
reviews.title: The Best Indian Single Origin I Have Ever Tasted
reviews.comment: Brewed on my Chemex with a 1:16 ratio. The hazelnut aroma filled the entire apartment, and the milk chocolate note is velvety smooth with zero bitterness. Unbelievable roast consistency.

reviews.name: Meera Venkat
reviews.title: Like Drinking Fresh Wild Blueberry Tea
reviews.comment: The Ethiopian Yirgacheffe is extraordinary. Light, crisp, with distinct notes of ripe blueberry and jasmine florals. Arrived just 2 days after roasting. Will never buy commercial beans again.

reviews.name: Karan Malhotra
reviews.title: Incredible Golden Crema on My Gaggia Classic
reviews.comment: Pulled an 18g in, 36g out shot in 28 seconds. The crema was over 5mm thick with gorgeous tiger striping. Makes the finest flat whites you can experience outside of Milan.

reviews.name: Dr. Shalini Iyer
reviews.title: Phenomenal Gift For Coffee Connoisseurs
reviews.comment: Ordered the tasting trio for my partner's birthday. The packaging is stunning, the beans were roasted 36 hours prior, and the cupping spoon was a wonderful surprise.

reviews.name: Arjun Nambiar
reviews.title: Daily Driver for Aeropress
reviews.comment: Super clean finish and very forgiving to brew. Even when I adjust the grind slightly, it always produces a sweet, balanced cup without any unpleasant sourness.

reviews.name: Nandita Sen
reviews.title: Exquisite Iced Pour-Over
reviews.comment: Brewed hot over Japanese ice spheres. The jasmine and bergamot notes shine through even more when chilled. Hands down the highest quality micro-lot available in India.

faqs.question: When was my coffee roasted?
faqs.answer: All Roastcraft coffees are roasted fresh to order every morning and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours of roasting. The exact roast date is hand-stamped on the back of each valved bag.

faqs.question: Should I order whole bean or pre-ground?
faqs.answer: We strongly recommend whole bean for maximum flavor and aroma. However, we also offer precision commercial grinding calibrated for Espresso, Pour-Over, Aeropress, French Press, and Cold Brew.

faqs.question: What is the best way to store my coffee beans?
faqs.answer: Store your beans inside our valved foil pouch in a cool, dark, dry pantry. Do not freeze or refrigerate roasted whole beans as condensation compromises delicate aromatic oils.

faqs.question: How does your free shipping policy work?
faqs.answer: All orders over ₹499 qualify for 100% complimentary express air courier delivery across India. Orders below ₹499 carry a nominal subsidized flat delivery charge of ₹70.
